ModMetaData.name: AI-Integrated Colonists
ModMetaData.author: Amy Hollon
ModMetaData.description:
Makes each colonist an autonomous agent driven by a local LLM — everything runs on your own hardware, nothing leaves your machine. Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: local Ollama (easiest, `ollama pull qwen2.5:3b` + point the settings at http://127.0.0.1:11434) or llama.cpp llama-server on a dedicated GPU box (launch scripts in the mod's server/ folder).
Three-layer design: Layer 1 gives each pawn impulses from sensory-framed perception (what they can actually do right now); Layer 2 simulates shared rooms in one batched call so colonists spontaneously chat, vent, and remark; Layer 3 consolidates memories into self-knowledge, long-term desires, and slow trait drift every few minutes. All LLM work happens on background threads — the main thread only pops pre-validated decisions in under 0.01 ms, so there are zero frame drops even at 50 colonists (district batching keeps large colonies covered).
Inspect any colonist's mind: the AI Mind tab shows their last inner monologue, long-term desire, recent memories, self-knowledge, continuous trait drift bars, and relationship vectors toward the people they know.
Player control is absolute: drafting purges pending desires instantly, manual orders always win, emergencies are handled by vanilla AI, and only player-faction colonists are LLM-eligible (prisoners/visitors never get evaluated). The mod degrades gracefully — with no server reachable it is completely inert.
Mod Settings includes per-layer URLs/model names, dual-clock timing ceilings, and one-click VRAM presets for CPU / single P100 / dual P100 hardware. Harmony is bundled — no other mods required. AI is disabled by default; enable it in Mod Settings once your inference endpoint is up.
